Case Group View

Ek Case ID ke andar kitne bills aur kitne payments hain — aur kya wo ek hi patient ke hain. Multi-bill case normal hai; agar ek Case ID par alag-alag patients mile to wo manual error hai aur review chahiye.

Ambiguous Matches — Review Required

Ye rows ek se zyada CSV record se milti hain, ya sirf partial match hui hai. Inka settlement data apply nahi kiya gaya — galat match se bachne ke liye. Har row confirm karke apply karo.

Unmatched Tracker Rows

Tracker me ye claims hain, lekin kisi bhi portal/CSV file me nahi mile — in par abhi tak koi payment nahi aayi, ya claim number galat hai.

Unmatched CSV Rows

Payment file me ye claims hain, lekin tracker me nahi mile — shayad tracker me entry reh gayi hai, ya kisi doosre period ki hai.

Duplicate Report

Duplicate claim numbers, duplicate UTRs aur duplicate portal records.

Master Claim Database

Har settlement run ke claims yahan permanently store hote hain. Excel kholne ki zaroorat nahi — patient name, claim number, UTR, bill number, UHID ya operator se turant dhoondo.

Settlement Audit Log

File uploads, settlement runs, exports aur duplicate detection — sab date aur time ke saath.
Rate = 0 → system portal ka apna rate use karta hai automatically (Pharmacy/Drug/Consumables ke liye — har bill mein alag hota hai, isko chhedo mat).
Rate = koi real number → wahi FIXED rate hamesha use hoga, portal ka rate ignore karke (Ward/Bed charges jaisi cheezon ke liye jahan aap khud control chahte ho).

Letterhead Printing System PDF + Print dono par lagta hai

Pre-printed letterhead paper ke liye blank area reserve karo. Ye reserved top area har page par khaali rehta hai (pehla page aur aage ke saare pages) — koi table row, patient info, total ya text uske andar nahi jaata. PDF me koi logo/hospital name/banner print nahi hota, taaki aapka chhapa hua letterhead saaf dikhe.
Default 60 mm. Same value har page par lagta hai.
Live Preview — A4

Manual Backup

Saara data is browser/computer ke andar hi save hota hai. Doosre computer par le jaane ya safety ke liye backup file download kar lo. Backup me: Bills + Local Rates + Settings + PDF History.

Automatic Backup

Restore Points

Hospital & Bill Settings

Bill Verification

Har saved bill ka ek verification code hota hai (QR me bhi wahi hai). Code yahan paste karke bill ki authenticity check karo.

Danger Zone

Ye sab data permanently delete kar dega. Pehle backup download kar lena.

Admin Mode

Billing hamesha approved CGHS master rates use karti hai. Normal use me rate change nahi ho sakta (Rate Lock). Master rate badalne ke liye Admin Mode on karo — ye sirf is device par, is session ke liye chalu hota hai.
Default PIN 2580 — niche se badal sakte ho.
Admin Mode ON — master CGHS rates ab editable hain. Kaam khatam hote hi band kar do.

Approved Master Rate Overrides

Yahan sirf woh CGHS codes dikhte hain jinka approved rate aapne badla hai. Baaki sab codes original CGHS master rate par hi bill hote hain.

Capabilities

Offline & Privacy

Poora software ek hi HTML file me hai. Koi bhi data internet par nahi jaata — PDF banana, compress karna, merge/split, Excel export, backup, sab kuch aapke browser ke andar hi hota hai. CGHS master rate table ( codes) bhi file ke andar embedded hai, isliye bina internet ke bhi sab chalta hai.

Error Logs

User Activity History

Storage & Diagnostics

Multi-Device Cloud Sync

How it works: ye app ek hi encrypted sync bundle file aapke cloud folder (Google Drive / OneDrive / Dropbox) me likhti hai. Aapka cloud us file ko baaki devices par pahuncha deta hai — PC par bill banao, phone par wahi file kholo, data mil jayega. App khud koi network call nahi karti, isliye offline kaam bhi chalta rehta hai.
Sync file ko apne Drive/OneDrive folder ke andar rakho. Har device par ek baar "Choose Sync File" karke wahi file select karni hai.
Endpoint ko GET /sync aur POST /sync support karna chahiye.
Manual option: bundle export karke WhatsApp/email/USB se doosre device par import kar lo.

Account & PIN Security

Change PIN

PIN kabhi plain text me store nahi hota — sirf salted SHA-256 hash rakha jaata hai.

Hospital Profile

Ye profile bill header aur reports me use hoti hai, aur sabhi devices par sync hoti hai.

Daily Backup

ZIP package me database, Excel reports, settlement reports, system settings, audit logs aur recent PDFs shaamil hote hain. 30 din ka retention rakha jaata hai.

Secure File Library

Generated PDFs, uploaded Excel files, settlement reports, tracker files aur backups — sab ek jagah. Preview, download, search aur delete kar sakte ho.

Audit Trail

Login, logout, bill create/edit/delete, settlement generation, backup download, restore, settings aur profile changes — date, time aur user ke saath.
